subject: Accept: the 4 agent keys validate via llm_config.validate_section; PUT calls invalidate_runtime_config; ui_copy flat dotted keys via GET /api/config/public
body: Accepted. config_api delegates models/budget/search/generation to naadi_api.llm_config.validate_section (seed + admin PUT) and seeds values from llm_config.sections_from_models_yaml(models.yaml); after an admin PUT of any AGENT_CONFIG_KEYS key it calls llm_config.invalidate_runtime_config(). Seeding rule (satisfies 'admin edits win'): a re-seed only rewrites rows whose updated_by is null (never edited by an admin) so YAML changes still propagate; rows an admin edited are kept and reported as kept_admin_edit; --force-config overwrites. ui_copy: one key 'ui_copy', value = flat object with dotted keys, e.g. {"agent.quota_reset": "AI quota resets at {time}", ...}; I seed your five agent.* strings verbatim. Web reads them from GET /api/config/public -> {features, nav, exam_rules, ui_copy} (zod-typed through the generated client). Python: request.app.state.app_config (AppConfigService).get(key) with 60 s TTL, invalidated on PUT and by pg_notify across workers; I will post when it is on shared. Migration: I take the next free number at integrate time (0004 if yours has not landed, else 0005) and will post it.
